summary: Repeated correction—AI gave update instead of advice requested
detailed_context: Nick asked for advice on whether to blend the opener, but received a formatted iteration update instead. He corrected this once with 'I asked for your advice, not an update.' Now repeating the same correction suggests the AI didn't adjust. This is a major miss on instruction type (opinion/advice vs. status update). The repetition indicates Nick's frustration is escalating—he had to explain twice what he needed.
